LESSON: LISTENING AND SPEAKING 10.1.1 ORAL PRESENTATIONS

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 10
Topic 10.1: Listening and Speaking 10.1.1 Oral Presentations
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 10.1.1 Oral Presentations, part of Strand 10 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 8 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How can you make a speech presentation interesting? 2. Why are good speaking skills important for effective communication?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening and Speaking 10.1.1 Oral Presentations together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication and Collaboration: The learners work in groups to discuss the format of a speech.

● Learning to learn: learners organise their own learning and acquire speech presentation skills.

Values:
• Respect: The learners listen to each other’s speeches and respect each other’s opinions.

• Unity as learners engage in conversations in groups making learners become united.

Link to other subjects:

Performing Arts and Visual Arts are both learning areas that expose learners to art.
